CARRICK_MINCORE_EXACT is the bisection hatch for first-touch residency observation, which arms a fault on each private anonymous page so mincore(2) can tell a written page from an untouched one. Default ON; =0 restores the previous behaviour, where every page of a live VMA reported resident. Read-only configuration selecting whether the arm runs; it carries no per-process state, so it is carrier-wide by construction and cannot be a scope defect.
